name: ai-team
description: AI Team — Claude Code agents that work together for a founder's company: lawyer, accountant, and more to come. Each agent is its own plugin; they share one private workspace in your project.

plugins.name: ai-lawyer
plugins.description: In-house legal research assistant: verifies every law against official sources, reviews contracts, keeps legal history, watches legal changes, improves itself. Not a licensed lawyer.

plugins.name: ai-accountant
plugins.description: In-house accounting & tax assistant: verifies every rule against official sources, registers documents, keeps the books' memory, month-end close, tax watch, improves itself. Never files, pays or signs.
